from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageChops, ImageOps
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
bg=im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(40))
d=np.asarray(im,dtype=float)-np.asarray(bg,dtype=float)  # negative where darker than surroundings
d=np.clip(-d,0,None)
# smooth
dimg=Image.fromarray(np.clip(d*3,0,255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(6))
a=np.asarray(dimg,dtype=float)
# mask out very bright (metal) and border
arr=np.asarray(im,dtype=float)
mask=(arr>200)
a[mask]=0
a[:150,:]=0; a[-60:,:]=0; a[:,:60]=0; a[:,-60:]=0
# find top local maxima via simple threshold
th=a.max()*0.6
ys,xs=np.where(a>th)
print('max',a.max(), 'n',len(ys))
# cluster roughly
pts=list(zip(xs.tolist(),ys.tolist(),a[ys,xs].tolist()))
pts.sort(key=lambda p:-p[2])
sel=[]
for x,y,v in pts:
    if all((x-sx)**2+(y-sy)**2>80**2 for sx,sy,_ in sel):
        sel.append((x,y,v))
for s in sel[:15]: print(s)
Image.fromarray(np.clip(a*2,0,255).astype('uint8')).save('/tmp/heat.png')
